LanguageData.SettlementMilitaryLevelDesc:
The measure of the settlements's military level.
The military level of a town directly affects the town's ability to defend itself as well as attack external threats
LanguageData.SettlementHappinessDesc:
The measure of the Settlement's overall happiness.
A high happiness means that any internal conflict within the settlement will lean heavily to your favor.
LanguageData.SettlementLoyaltyDesc:
The measure of the Settlement's overall loyalty.
The loyalty of a settlement determines how willing the settlement is to listen to you. A high loyalty will reduce the chance of defection.
LanguageData.SettlementUnrestDesc:
The measure of the Settlement's overall unrest.
The higher unrest grows, the more likely dangerous events internal in your Settlement will spark. Let it grow too high, and a Settlement-wide revolt may grow.
LanguageData.SettlementProsperityDesc:
The measure of the Settlement's overall prosperity.
The prosperity of a town directly correlates with the production of resources (e.g. 50% prosperity = 50% production). If prosperity is damaged, it will slowly accumulate over time.
LanguageData.FCUnsupportedSettlementFaction: The faction of this settlement has no name or something went terribly wrong.
LanguageData.FCDescSeaIce: Endless sheets of ice unbroken by nothing but small, sparse wildlife. No food grows except within heated rooms. Only the most tenacious of life survives here.
LanguageData.FCDescIceSheet: Bleak, unending frost blankets the land, interrupted only by outcroppings of stone and ruins. The only source of food is the hardy wildlife which calls this place its home.
LanguageData.FCDescTundra: The hinterland houses a variety of rugged flora and fauna eking out an existance on the moss-covered landscape. When the summer comes, the land blooms into life, if only briefly.
LanguageData.FCDescColdBog: The rugged beauty of this land is matched only by its inhospitability. Marshes dot the landscape, as do frequent packs of migrating herbivores and the predators that hunt them.
LanguageData.FCDescBorealForest: While typically less cold than the hinterland of a tundra, a boreal forest's harsh winter weather is only matched by its warm summers, where greenery briefly blooms and food becomes plentiful.
LanguageData.FCDescTropicalRainforest: Trees choke the sky, ensuring little light reaches the floor. Yet under the canopy, there exists a dazzling, but deadly, array of flora and fauna. The beauty of this biome is matched only by the dangers within.
LanguageData.FCDescTemperateForest: Abundant forests and streams split the land. Animals roam the thick forests and both food and shelter are aplenty.
LanguageData.FCDescTemperateSwamp: The land is covered by bogs and marshes, and what isn't, is covered by a variety of vegetation. Available building space is at a premium here.
LanguageData.FCDescTropicalSwamp: The land is strangled by thick vegetation as trees reach for the sky, ensuring little light reaches the treacherous grounds. Disease is rampant and frequent.
LanguageData.FCDescAridShrubland: While not a true desert, growing soil is at a premium thanks to the relentless heat. Most of the land is open, with secluded groves breaking the otherwise empty skyline.
LanguageData.FCDescDesert: Arable soil is a rarity, as the majority of the land here is covered in sand, some too treacherous to build on. Still, life clings to existance here, and the sands harbour a vibrant array of life.
LanguageData.FCDescExtremeDesert: The sun has baked this land into a wasteland. There is almost no soil that can support proper vegetation, and that which there is, is poor in quality.
LanguageData.FCDescUnknown: Little is widely known about the surrounding land, but the colony manages to survive and prosper in their present conditions.
LanguageData.FCDescOrbitalSpace: The vast emptiness of space stretches in all directions, broken only by the distant twinkle of stars and the occasional passing asteroid. Solar panels gleam in the eternal sunlight, while life support systems hum quietly in the artificial environment. The station floats in the void, a beacon of civilization in the cosmic wilderness.
LanguageData.FCTownLevel1: The settlement itself is simply a small cluster of buildings grouped around a central structure.
LanguageData.FCTownLevel2: The settlement is dominated by a few large structures, but it is still quite small. A number of sandbags and barricades ring the outside.
LanguageData.FCTownLevel3: The settlement has a good number of structures — largely production oriented — as well as dedicated storehouses, and busy workers scurry between them. A modest wall protects the settlement.
LanguageData.FCTownLevel4: The settlement is reasonably large, and well organised, with a number of industrial buildings clustered together to maximize efficiency. A thick wall and internal defenses protect the colony from attack.
LanguageData.FCTownLevel5: Clearly labelled buildings mark the industrial heart of this bustling beacon of civilization, as well as various other utilities. Multiple walls ring the colony, with plentiful interior defenses in carefully planned chokepoints.
LanguageData.BuildingInvalidEnvironment: That building cannot be built on this settlement's biome!
